calling the partially latent presence/absence states z, all you have to do is to add "z" to the parameters.to.save list.

Best regards  --- Marc

From: hmec...@googlegroups.com <hmec...@googlegroups.com> on behalf of Joshua Hubbell <jhubbel...@gmail.com>
Sent: Wednesday, June 29, 2022 03:47
To: hmecology: Hierarchical Modeling in Ecology <hmec...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: Extracting Species Occurrences From DA Multi-Species Occupancy Model
 
Hi All,

Quick question,

I'm implementing the DA multi-species occupancy model as described in AHM Vol. 1, and cannot remember whether the  species occurrences have to be specified as a parameter (e.g., Mu Psi [K]) that you want JAGS to estimate if you wish to obtain all of them.  I would assume this to be the case, but just wanted some clarification to make sure. Also, if that is the case, any example code highlighting how that might be done would be great as well.

Thanks!


Josh
